# Supportive AI

> AI receptionist for UK trade businesses (plumbers, electricians, HVAC, window cleaners). Answers calls 24/7, books jobs into live calendars, handles pricing questions, detects emergencies, texts confirmations to both parties. From £69/month.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://supportive-ai.com): Overview of the AI receptionist platform
- [Pricing](https://supportive-ai.com/pricing): Three tiers — Starter £69/mo, Professional £149/mo, Business £299/mo
- [How It Works](https://supportive-ai.com/how-it-works): 3-step setup process
- [Demo](https://supportive-ai.com/demo): Live demo phone numbers you can call right now
- [Compare](https://supportive-ai.com/compare): AI receptionist vs human answering service vs voicemail
